## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the commands or checks you ran.

## Release intent

Releases are derived from this pull request's title, which becomes the squash
commit subject. Individual commit subjects on the branch do not matter.

- [ ] Release-worthy changes use `fix`, `perf`, `feat`, or a breaking marker.
- [ ] Changes that do not affect a published module use a non-releasing type.
